VHAPG Part 813.106 Simplified Acquisition Procedures: Soliciting from a Single Source Attachment 1: Single Source Justification for SAP under the SAT

DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS

Justification for Single Source Awards IAW FAR 13.106-1 For Over Micro-Purchase Threshold but Not Exceeding the SAT ($250K) Acquisition Plan Action ID: █████████████████████████

1. Contracting Activity: Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 16 (NCO 16), 5075 Westheimer Road, Suite 750, Houston, TX 77056 In support of the Southeast Louisiana Veteran Healthcare System (SLVHCS), 2400 Cancel Street, New Orleans, LA 70119.

Requisition Number: █████████████████████████

2. Brief Description of Supplies/ Services required and the intended use/Estimated Amount:

The contractor is responsible for providing the equipment, labor, materials, accessories, and supplies required for complete Intraoperative Neuromonitoring Service (IONM). This acquisition covers an all-inclusive service on a case-by-case basis, enabling SLVHCS to offer IONM options for patients under direct medical care in the operating room. The IONM services must be capable of supporting complex surgical procedures, including Spine Surgery, Neurosurgery, Vascular Surgery, Otolaryngology, Cardiac Surgery, Thoracic Surgery, Orthopedics, and, if necessary, Interventional Neuroradiology, for a two-month period from November 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025.

In accordance with (IAW) FAR 13.5 Simplified Procedures for Certain Commercial Items, and specifically FAR 13.501 Special Documentation Requirements, acquisitions conducted under Simplified Acquisition Procedures are exempt from the requirements of FAR Part 6, but still require a justification using the format of FAR 6.303-2. SLVHCS urgently requests these IONM services. █████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ ██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████

3. Unique characteristics that limit availability to only one source, with the reason no other supplies or services can be used:

The SLVHCS requires continuous surgical services, as the current contract (36C25624P0801) is set to expire on October 31, 2025. This new contract will serve as a two-month emergency measure until a long-term contract is finalized. This emergency contract is necessary to avoid disruptions in IONM services, as any delay in awarding a new contract could lead to medical complications for our Veterans. Given the immediate necessity to maintain IONM services to ensure stable care for Veterans, this requirement must be sole sourced under Unusual and Compelling Urgency to protect patient safety.

The market for qualified vendors is limited due to the low volume of surgical cases, resulting in a small pool of interested companies.
